title: feat(app-shell): a key-only record control, and the Studio hook form offers refusals with it (#26835)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8G6QZjYQCXktarYR4vyuASc)_
Fixes #26835

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 钩子表单新增「Refusals」一行,可以逐条填写拒绝码、提示语和状态码;表单的 record 编辑器新增一个通用的「只用键」模式,任何 record 字段声明后都能用。
- 为什么改:原来的 record 编辑器会把键名写进每个条目,而钩子的拒绝条目是封闭对象,写进去就被 spec 拒收,所以 Studio 里根本没法配置可翻译的拒绝提示。
- 风险与回滚:只有声明了 `widget: 'key-only-record'` 的字段走新逻辑,其余 record 字段行为不变(有测试钉住);回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` 的 RecordField 改动(键名不写入、改名逻辑);`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts` 新增的一行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx`,预期 8 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Key-only record face** (`SchemaForm.tsx`, `RecordField`). A `type: 'record'` form row that declares `widget: 'key-only-record'` (`KEY_ONLY_RECORD_WIDGET`) edits a map of closed entries: add, rename, remove and reorder keys, and edit each entry's fields, without writing the key into the entry. A key is checked against the record's served key rule (`propertyNames.pattern`, which the server derives from the spec's key schema), so the rule is never restated in the UI. A rename moves the entry in place once the typed key is valid, so an invalid intermediate spelling stays typeable. A record row with no such widget is untouched: the key is still mirrored into the entry.
- **Hook form** (`packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`). The Body section offers `refusals` with that control, with `message` (textarea, required) and `status` (number) per entry.
- **Gate ledger** (`metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`). The `hook` root omission row for `refusals` that the hook refusal catalogue PR recorded is removed: the form now offers the key, and the reconciliation reads `refusals.message` / `refusals.status` against `HookRefusalSchema`.
- **i18n.** `engine.form.key` (en `Key`, zh `键名`) names the key column when the form declares no key label.
- **Translations.** The generated metadata-form bundles carry the three refusals rows, translated in zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES; three platform-objects census pins and one cli coverage filter move with them.
- **Changeset.** Patch for `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Why

After the hook refusal catalogue landed, a hook can declare `refusals: { CODE: { message, status? } }` so its refusal messages are translatable, but the Studio hook form could not author it: the generic record editor stamps each key into its entry (`name` by default), and a refusal entry is closed at `message` / `status`, so the stamped key is refused. The card asked for a generic key-only record control, opted into by declaration, and for the hook form to use it.

## Tests

New file `SchemaForm.keyOnlyRecord-26835.test.tsx` (8 tests). Everything it reads comes from the spec: the form row is `hookForm`'s own, the field schema is the served derivation of `HookSchema` (`z.toJSONSchema` with `io: 'input'`), and the key rule is checked equal to `HOOK_REFUSAL_CODE_PATTERN.source`.

- the hook form declares `refusals` as a record on the key-only face;
- adding an entry writes no key into it;
- a key that breaks the served rule (`clean_version`) is refused and the value is unchanged;
- a rename moves the entry in place, unstamped, through an invalid intermediate spelling; a rename onto an existing key is refused;
- round trip: two refusals authored in the form save a body `HookSchema` accepts, the parsed `refusals` serialise byte-identical to the saved ones, and the saved body reloads into the same rows in the same order;
- control: a record row with no widget still mirrors the key, and `HookSchema` refuses that body with `unrecognized_keys` `['name']` at the entry.

Ablation, one-off, restored by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (blob back to HEAD `892c144b`, `git diff HEAD` empty): `const keyOnly = widget === KEY_ONLY_RECORD_WIDGET;` replaced with `const keyOnly = false;` (the hook row falls back to the stamping editor) turns 4 of 8 red, the round trip among them; the 4 that stay green are the declaration, the served-rule and the default-face pins, which do not read the face.

## Acceptance notes

- The control refuses a bad key with the generic `engine.form.keyPattern` text naming the served pattern, not with the sentence `HookSchema` attaches to the record key ("A refusal code is SCREAMING_SNAKE …"). That sentence is inline in `hook.zod.ts` and the served JSON Schema does not carry it, so a generic control has no way to read it without restating it. The row's own help text states the spelling.
- `keyField.field`, `regex` and `immutable` are not read on the key-only face (nothing is stamped, and a key is always renamable). Declaring `keyField` on such a row would also make the reconciliation gate count `keyField.field` as an offered member, so the hook row declares none.

## Verification

Local, on the branch head named in the report: the new file 8/8; `ui` vitest over `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` and `packages/i18n/` 727 files green; spec vitest over `src/system/`, `src/data/hook*.test.ts`, `src/kernel/repeater-item-titles.test.ts` 65 files / 2208 tests green; `type-check` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@objectstack/spec` and `type-check:scripts` exit 0. The derived gate list (84 commands) is reconciled with `dispatch-gates --ran` in the report; `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` need a whole-repo build and are left to CI's Lint and Repo Gates.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (CI).

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
